pattern_1.transformation: Parse local timestamp and convert to ISO 8601 UTC format. Local time treated as Mountain Standard Time (fixed UTC-7, Etc/GMT+7); the logger record is not daylight-saving adjusted.
Use the sensor Point.Location (upper/lower zone within each warming plot) as site_id; it is the finest-grained spatial identifier and matches the sensor metadata keys.
Look up 'Depth.cm' for each payload 'Sensor.SN' among the SWC rows of sensor_metadata.csv. One SWC serial number lacks a recorded depth, leaving 36 payload rows with NA depth.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Divide by 100 to convert from cm to m.

pattern_1.transformation: Number co-located sensors sequentially within each (datetime_UTC, site_id, depth_m) group; multiple SWC sensors are deployed at the same point and depth.

Filter payload to rows where Sensor.Type == 'SWC' and rename the 'Measurement' value. Heated-plot records (ER-WM2/4/6/8/10) are confounded with the warming treatment and can be filtered downstream if an ambient-only signal is required.
